name: YouTube
description: Your YouTube playlists (Liked videos, Watch later and your own) and any playlist you link, each a playlist in Plex. Sign in with a code. Videos play from YouTube up to 1080p, H.264 with AAC, which every Plex app plays; rex joins picture and sound without converting either. Nothing is downloaded. Other addons (Spotify) can find songs on YouTube and play their sound through it.

config.label: Videos per playlist: the first ones in its order (Liked videos: the newest)
Highest quality: 1080, 720, 480 or 360 (360 plays YouTube's 360p MP4 as it is, with no conversion)
More playlists: links to anyone's public or unlisted playlist
